title: Even Noise Slopes Down
summary: Word frequency really does fall off as roughly one over rank. But sorting counts by size and fitting a line slopes downward whether there is a law underneath or not, and on a short passage it slopes nearly as steeply on noise.

sources.title: Zipf, Human Behavior and the Principle of Least Effort (1949)
Baayen, Word Frequency Distributions (2001), on estimation from finite samples
Clauset, Shalizi and Newman, Power-law distributions in empirical data, SIAM Review 51 (2009)
